title: Currency not supported
customer_explanation: This payment is in a currency your account cannot receive. Tallybridge accounts can receive only EUR, USD and GBP.
customer_action: Ask the payer to pay in EUR, USD or GBP to the receiving details for that currency. You find your receiving details in the app.

title: Sender name does not match
customer_explanation: The sender name on this incoming payment does not match.
customer_action: Contact support with the amount, the currency and the date of the payment. Our team will check it.

title: Account not verified
customer_explanation: Your account has not finished the identity check, so the payment cannot be received.
customer_action: Finish your identity check in the app. The KYC review (Starter, Verified) takes 1–2 business days. The KYB review (Business) takes 3–5 business days.

title: Payment held for review
customer_explanation: We are reviewing this incoming payment. A review takes up to 3 business days. We may ask you for an invoice or contract.
customer_action: Check your messages in the app and your email. If we ask for an invoice or contract, upload it.

title: Monthly receive limit reached
customer_explanation: This payment is over the monthly receive limit of your tier: €1,000 (Starter), €30,000 (Verified) or €250,000 (Business). Limits are in EUR equivalent.
customer_action: Monthly limits reset on the 1st day of the month. For higher limits, move to a higher tier or, on Verified and Business, ask for a limit increase.

title: Daily withdrawal limit reached
customer_explanation: Your withdrawals today reached the daily limit of your tier: €500 (Starter), €10,000 (Verified) or €50,000 (Business). Limits are in EUR equivalent.
customer_action: Try again after the limit resets at 00:00 CET, or withdraw a smaller amount.

title: Monthly withdrawal limit reached
customer_explanation: Your withdrawals this month reached the monthly limit of your tier: €1,000 (Starter), €30,000 (Verified) or €250,000 (Business). Limits are in EUR equivalent.
customer_action: You can withdraw again after the limit resets on the 1st day of the month.

title: Beneficiary bank rejected
customer_explanation: The receiving bank rejected this withdrawal. The money goes back to your balance in 3–7 business days. The withdrawal fee is not charged.
customer_action: Check the bank details with your bank. Then create the withdrawal again.

title: Balance too low for withdrawal and fee
customer_explanation: Your balance does not cover the withdrawal amount plus the withdrawal fee (€1.50 for SEPA, €15 for SWIFT).
customer_action: Lower the amount so that the amount and the fee fit in your balance, then try again.

title: IBAN invalid
customer_explanation: The IBAN you entered is not valid.
customer_action: Copy the IBAN exactly from your bank and enter it again.

title: SWIFT/BIC details invalid
customer_explanation: The SWIFT/BIC details you entered are not valid.
customer_action: Ask your bank for the correct SWIFT/BIC code and bank details. Then create the withdrawal again.

title: SEPA not available
customer_explanation: SEPA is only for EUR to a bank account in the EU. It is not available for this currency or country.
customer_action: Use a SWIFT withdrawal instead. A SWIFT withdrawal costs €15 and takes 2–5 business days.

title: Beneficiary name does not match
customer_explanation: The name of the beneficiary does not match the account holder. You can withdraw only to a bank account in your own name.
customer_action: Use a bank account in your own name. Enter the name exactly as your bank has it.

title: Withdrawal returned
customer_explanation: The receiving bank returned this withdrawal. The money goes back to your balance in 3–7 business days. The withdrawal fee is not charged.
customer_action: Check the bank details with your bank. Then create the withdrawal again.

title: Mass Payouts need the Business tier
customer_explanation: Mass Payouts are only available on the Business tier.
customer_action: To use Mass Payouts, move to the Business tier. This needs company documents and details of the owners (KYB).

title: Too many recipients in the file
customer_explanation: Your mass payout file has more than 500 recipients. One file can have up to 500 recipients.
customer_action: Split the recipients into files of 500 recipients or fewer and upload each file.

title: Insufficient balance
customer_explanation: Your balance is too low for this card payment. The card spends from your Tallybridge balance.
customer_action: Add money to your balance and try the payment again.

title: Card frozen
customer_explanation: This card is frozen, so the payment was declined.
customer_action: Unfreeze the card in the app if it is safe, then try again.

title: Card PIN blocked after 3 wrong PINs
customer_explanation: Your card PIN is blocked after 3 wrong PINs.
customer_action: Unblock the PIN in the app. Then use the right PIN.

title: Card cancelled
customer_explanation: This card is cancelled and cannot be used.
customer_action: Use another active card. Contact support if you need a new card.

title: Merchant category blocked
customer_explanation: The card cannot be used for this type of merchant. Blocked categories are gambling, crypto exchanges and adult content.
customer_action: Use another way to pay this merchant.

title: Wrong PIN
customer_explanation: The PIN you entered is wrong. After 3 wrong PINs the PIN is blocked.
customer_action: Try again with the right PIN.

title: 3-D Secure failed
customer_explanation: The online security check (3-D Secure) for this payment was not completed.
customer_action: Try the payment again and complete the security check.

title: Daily card spend limit reached
customer_explanation: Your card payments today reached the daily spend limit: €5,000 (Verified) or €15,000 (Business). Limits are in EUR equivalent.
customer_action: Try again after the limit resets at 00:00 CET.

title: Daily ATM withdrawal limit reached
customer_explanation: Your ATM withdrawals today reached the daily limit: €1,000 (Verified) or €2,000 (Business). Limits are in EUR equivalent.
customer_action: Try again after the limit resets at 00:00 CET.

title: Document unreadable
customer_explanation: We could not read your document.
customer_action: Upload a new, clear photo or scan. The whole document must be visible.

title: Document expired
customer_explanation: Your document has expired.
customer_action: Upload a document that is still valid.

title: ID document type not supported
customer_explanation: We do not accept this type of ID document. We accept a passport, a national ID card, or a driving licence from the EU or UK.
customer_action: Upload a passport, a national ID card, or a driving licence from the EU or UK.

title: Driving licence not from the EU or UK
customer_explanation: We accept driving licences only from the EU or UK.
customer_action: Upload a passport or a national ID card instead.

title: Selfie does not match
customer_explanation: Your selfie does not match the photo on your ID document.
customer_action: Take a new selfie. Make sure your face is clearly visible.

title: Proof of address too old
customer_explanation: Your proof of address is older than 3 months.
customer_action: Upload a utility bill or bank statement that is not older than 3 months.

title: Wrong proof of address
customer_explanation: Your proof of address is not a utility bill or a bank statement.
customer_action: Upload a utility bill or a bank statement that is not older than 3 months.

title: Proof of source of income missing
customer_explanation: The Verified tier needs proof of your source of income. It is missing.
customer_action: Upload a document that shows your source of income.

title: Business documents incomplete
customer_explanation: Your company documents or the details of the owners are incomplete.
customer_action: Upload the missing company documents or complete the owner details. The KYB review takes 3–5 business days.

title: Country not supported
customer_explanation: Tallybridge cannot open or serve accounts in this country.
customer_action: We cannot open an account for this country.

title: Login locked
customer_explanation: Your login is locked for 30 minutes after 5 wrong passwords.
customer_action: Wait 30 minutes, then log in with the correct password. If you did not try to log in, contact support.

title: Wrong password
customer_explanation: The password you entered is wrong. After 5 wrong passwords, your login is locked for 30 minutes.
customer_action: Check your password and try again.

title: 2FA code invalid
customer_explanation: The 2FA code you entered is not valid.
customer_action: Enter the newest code from your authenticator app or SMS. Never share this code with anyone, including Tallybridge staff.

title: 2FA not set up
customer_explanation: Two-factor authentication (2FA) is mandatory, and it is not set up on your account.
customer_action: Set up 2FA with an authenticator app or SMS.

title: Account under review
customer_explanation: Your account is under review. Our team may contact you for documents. A review typically takes up to 10 business days.
customer_action: Check your messages in the app and your email. If our team asks for documents, upload them.

title: Identity check not finished
customer_explanation: Your identity check is not finished. Until it is finished, you can only log in and upload documents.
customer_action: Upload your verification documents in the app. The KYC review (Starter, Verified) takes 1–2 business days. The KYB review (Business) takes 3–5 business days.

title: Account has a balance
customer_explanation: Your account cannot be closed while it has a balance.
customer_action: Withdraw your balance first. The account is closed 30 days after your request.

title: Limit increase not available on Starter
customer_explanation: A limit increase is possible only for Verified and Business accounts.
customer_action: Move to the Verified tier for higher limits. You need proof of address and proof of source of income.
